title: pkpdutils: pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic analysis of timecourses and parameters

creators.affiliation: Humboldt-University Berlin, Faculty of Life Science, Institute for Biology, Berlin; University Lübeck; University Hospital Schleswig-Holstein, Campus Lübeck, First Department of Medicine, Germany
creators.name: König, Matthias

description:
pkpdutils is a python library for the pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic analysis of timecourses and parameters with source code available from https://github.com/matthiaskoenig/pkpdutils.

Features include

  • non-compartmental analysis of concentration and effect timecourses
  • uncertainty propagation for group data
  • curve fitting of exponential, Emax, dose proportionality and covariate models
  • significance tests, bioequivalence, drug-drug interaction classification and meta-analysis of pharmacokinetic parameters

The documentation is available on https://matthiaskoenig.github.io/pkpdutils. The package was formerly published as pkdb-analysis.

If you have any questions or issues please open an issue
